info.name: SpinWatch Big Data Pipeline Verification Collection
info.description:
Postman Collection for inspecting telemetry data at every stage of the SpinWatch Pipeline:
- Point 1: Stream Telemetry Ingress (POST & GET /api/readings/)
- Point 2: Kafka Ecosystem & Partitions (GET /api/kafka/status)
- Point 3a: Kafka Connect Storage Sinks (GET /api/connect/status)
- Point 3b: HDFS Landed Raw Telemetry & Long-Period Time-Travel (GET /api/hdfs/raw & /api/hdfs/history?dt=YYYY-MM-DD)
- Point 3c: MySQL Operational Storage (GET /api/sql/readings)
- Point 4a: PySpark MLlib Predictive Failure Model (GET /api/predictions)
- Point 4b: PySpark Heat Insights (GET /api/insights)

request.description: Submits a raw washer heat reading to the REST Ingress API for forwarding to Apache Kafka.
Inspects recent stream readings received by the ingress server.

item.name: Point 2: Kafka Topic & Partition Status Check

request.description: Inspects Kafka topic 'machine-readings', 3 partitions, consumer group, and partition key strategy.

item.name: Point 3a: Kafka Connect Automatic Sinks Check

request.description: Inspects status of Kafka Connect sinks: mysql-sink-laundry and hdfs-sink-laundry.

item.name: Point 3b: HDFS Landed Historical Data Check

request.description: Inspects raw telemetry records landed in HDFS directory (/data/machines/raw/) in Parquet/JSON format.

item.name: Point 3c: HDFS Historical Time-Travel Date Query

request.description: Queries historical telemetry records stored in a specific HDFS date partition (dt=YYYY-MM-DD).
Queries MySQL database 'laundry_ops' for landed readings and washer operational status summaries.

item.name: Point 4a: PySpark MLlib Predictive Model Scoring Check

request.description: Fetches PySpark MLlib LogisticRegression predictive failure flags (breakdown_soon = 1 vs 0) stored in HDFS.
Fetches PySpark calculated branch temperature averages and top overheating machine alert counts stored in HDFS.
